input.summary: Fix Section 6.11 audit terms: annual frequency, 15 days' prior written notice, Harpoon bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 6.11 lets Harpoon call an audit on request with no notice period, and leaves the audit frequency and the cost-shifting threshold open. We have set the audit at no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, required fifteen (15) days' prior written notice, and confirmed Harpoon bears the audit cost unless the audit reveals an underpayment of more than ten percent (10%).

ops.oldText: At the request of Harpoon, AbbVie shall permit an independent public accounting firm of nationally recognized standing designated by Harpoon
ops.newText: At the request of Harpoon, upon at least fifteen (15) days' prior written notice, AbbVie shall permit an independent public accounting firm of nationally recognized standing designated by Harpoon

ops.oldText: be conducted more than once in any [***] period
ops.newText: be conducted more than once in any twelve (12) month period

ops.oldText: unless the audit reveals a variance [***] from the reported amounts or [***], in which case
ops.newText: unless the audit reveals an underpayment of more than ten percent (10%) of the reported amounts, in which case
